links.outcome: AI-VIA sensitivity and specificity versus expert consensus on local patients, compared with nurse assessment
links.effect: AI sensitivity 33.3% (95% CI 18.0–51.8), specificity 92.2% (87.8–95.4); nurse sensitivity 51.5%, specificity 98.2%.
links.quote: Relative to expert consensus, nurse assessment demonstrated higher screening performance than the AI algorithm, with sensitivity 51.5% (95% CI 33.5–69.2) and specificity 98.2% (95% CI 95.4–99.5) versus sensitivity 33.3% (95% CI 18.0–51.8) and specificity 92.2% (95% CI 87.8–95.4).

unlisted_practices: Mapping implementation barriers and facilitators with CFIR and selecting ERIC implementation strategies

screen.reason: Prospective mixed-methods clinical implementation study evaluating the real-world diagnostic performance of an AI-assisted VIA tool and qualitative implementation determinants using CFIR.
